title: Racial Promotion Gaps
authors: Hegde, Deepak, Ljungqvist, Alexander, Raj, Manav
official: 来源期次 American Economic Review · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: We study racial disparities in promotions in a setting in which promotions are formulaic: the US patent office. Using detailed administrative data that allow us to observe who is eligible for promotion when, we document that Black patent examiners experience delays in promotions they are entitled to, slowing their climb to the top of the career ladder by a year and reducing career earnings by 2.9%. Institutional features rule out statistical discrimination with accurate priors. Slow promotions even under Black supervisors argue against taste-based animus. Instead, the patterns fit models of belief-based discrimination.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了在晋升流程高度程式化的情境——美国专利局——中存在的种族晋升差异。利用详尽的行政数据，我们得以观察特定时间点符合晋升条件的群体，发现黑人专利审查员在应得晋升中遭遇延迟，导致其职业阶梯顶端晋升速度放缓一年，职业生涯收入减少2.9%。制度特征排除了基于准确先验信息的统计性歧视。即使在黑人主管领导下仍存在晋升缓慢现象，这否定了基于偏好的歧视解释。相反，这些模式符合基于信念的歧视模型。

title: Shaping Institutions
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Applied Economics · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: We propose a simple model of the evolution of institutional strength, where leaders' actions have a persistent effect by shaping the norms of the institutions they lead. This leads to different long-run behaviors even for institutions with the same formal rules. The early history of leaders plays a crucial role in determining which outcome prevails. Every period, a leader decides to respect or abuse their position. Respect strengthens the institutions; abuse weakens them. Leader's type and institutional strength determine both the benefit/cost of abusing the position and the replacement probability. We elucidate democratic backsliding and corporate-board capturing.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个关于制度强度演化的简单模型，其中领导者的行为通过塑造其领导机构的规范而产生持久影响。即使正式规则相同的制度，也会因此产生不同的长期行为。领导者的早期经历在决定最终结果中起着关键作用。每个时期，领导者都会决定是尊重还是滥用其职位。尊重会强化制度，滥用则会削弱制度。领导者的类型和制度强度共同决定了滥用职位的收益/成本以及被替换的概率。我们阐释了民主倒退和公司董事会俘获现象。

title: The Dynamics of Global Sourcing
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Microeconomics · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: This paper studies a model of heterogeneous importers that incorporates static cross-country interdependence and dynamic dependence in firmlevel decisions. Using data on Chinese importers between 2000–2006, I find that source countries are complementary, i.e., the benefit of importing from one country increases as a firm imports from more countries. Accounting for this complementarity, I estimate the sunk costs of importing, which make establishing relationships with new suppliers costlier than maintaining existing ones. I illustrate how the sunk cost estimates depend on cross-country interdependence and model specifications, such as the inclusion of export decisions.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个异质性进口商模型，该模型融合了企业层面决策的静态跨国相互依赖性与动态依赖性。基于2000-2006年中国进口商数据，研究发现来源国之间存在互补性，即企业从一国进口的收益会随其进口来源国数量的增加而提升。在考虑这种互补性的基础上，本文估算了进口的沉没成本——建立新供应商关系的成本高于维持现有关系的成本。研究进一步揭示了沉没成本估算如何受跨国相互依赖性与模型设定（如是否纳入出口决策）的影响。

title: Friends or Neighbors? Advice Networks, Geographic Proximity, and the Transmission of Health Knowledge
title_zh: 朋友还是邻居？建议网络、地理邻近性与健康知识的传播
authors: Yves Zenou, Nicholas Christakis, Michael Vlassopoulos
official: 官方在线 2026-07-01 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Public-health interventions often aspire to generate spillovers beyond the households they directly reach, but identifying who is exposed to whom within communities is challenging. Researchers frequently approximate social exposure using geographic proximity, even though the individuals who transmit health advice need not be nearby. We study this issue by conducting secondary analysis of a randomized maternal and child health counseling intervention in rural Honduras with geocoded households and mapped social networks. At our main 50-meter radius, geographic proximity captures only 30.8% of health-advice ties, while only 3.7% of geographically proximate household pairs are connected by advice-giving. The choice of exposure mapping matters for what the analysis detects. Exposure mappings based solely on geographic proximity yield a precise zero effect on diarrhea knowledge. By contrast, exposure through advice ties beyond 50 meters increases diarrhea knowledge, and the effect is statistically distinguishable from exposure through nearby non-advice contacts. The evidence suggests that simple, actionable illness-management knowledge diffuses through advice relationships that geographic proximity alone fails to capture. Reported diarrhea, indicating whether the respondent or any child had diarrhea in the previous four weeks, also increases with advice exposure outside 50m, consistent with greater recognition, recall, or reporting rather than higher underlying morbidity. We find no corresponding effects for respiratory knowledge or reported respiratory illness. Our results show that using geographic proximity as a proxy for social exposure can mask important channels of information transmission and could lead researchers to miss meaningful spillover effects.
abstract_zh: 公共卫生干预措施往往期望在直接覆盖的家庭之外产生溢出效应，但识别社区内谁与谁接触具有挑战性。研究人员常以地理邻近性近似衡量社会接触，尽管传播健康建议的个体未必相邻。我们通过对洪都拉斯农村地区一项随机母婴健康咨询干预进行二次分析来研究这一问题，该干预包含地理编码家庭和映射社会网络数据。在主要50米半径范围内，地理邻近性仅捕捉到30.8%的健康建议联系，而仅有3.7%的地理邻近家庭对存在建议传递关系。暴露映射的选择会影响分析结果。仅基于地理邻近性的暴露映射显示对腹泻知识的影响精确为零。相反，通过50米外建议联系产生的暴露能提升腹泻知识，其效应在统计上显著区别于邻近非建议接触的暴露。证据表明，简单可行的疾病管理知识通过建议关系传播，而单纯地理邻近性无法捕捉这种关系。报告腹泻（反映受访者或任何儿童在过去四周内是否出现腹泻）也随50米外建议暴露增加而增加，这与更高的认知、回忆或报告率一致，而非潜在发病率上升。我们未发现呼吸系统知识或报告呼吸系统疾病存在相应效应。研究结果表明，将地理邻近性作为社会接触的代理变量可能掩盖重要的信息传播渠道，并导致研究者遗漏有意义的溢出效应。

title: Trading Frictions in Dynamic Cap-and-Trade Markets
title_zh: 动态限额与交易市场中的交易摩擦
authors: Nicola Borri, Yukun Liu, Aleh Tsyvinski, Xi Wu
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We develop a dynamic stochastic model of markets with an externality and multiple trading frictions, and cap-and-trade as the leading application. Slow participation, limited intermediation, and heterogeneous information interact in equilibrium: agents choose costly market access, access determines residual compliance demand, intermediary constraints translate residual demand into a surrender-month premium, and the premium feeds back into access incentives. These interactions shape how effectively the market corrects the externality. We characterize access choices in closed form, prove that the equilibrium premium is unique, and show that endogenous access dampens the response to each friction in isolation, while the interaction of multiple frictions is non-additive and can amplify the price response. We quantify the model using 2.7 million EU ETS registry transactions and compliance records from 2005–2021. About 40% of operators do not trade annually, purchases concentrate in April when returns are systematically high, and operator flow predicts future returns.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含外部性与多重交易摩擦的市场动态随机模型，并以限额与交易制度作为主要应用场景。缓慢参与、有限中介与异质信息在均衡中相互作用：代理人选择成本高昂的市场准入，准入决定剩余合规需求，中介约束将剩余需求转化为交割月溢价，而溢价又反馈至准入激励。这些相互作用塑造了市场纠正外部性的效率。我们以闭式解刻画准入选择，证明均衡溢价的唯一性，并表明内生准入会削弱单一摩擦的价格响应，而多重摩擦的交互作用具有非加总性，可能放大价格效应。基于2005-2021年间270万条欧盟排放交易体系（EU ETS）登记交易与合规记录进行量化分析发现：约40%的运营商未进行年度交易，购买集中在回报率系统性偏高的四月，且运营商资金流向可预测未来收益。

title: Incentives, Evidence, and Reminders for Bureaucrats: Overcoming Barriers to Policy Scale Up
title_zh: 激励、证据与对官僚的提醒：克服政策推广的障碍
authors: Patrick Agte, Daniel R. Morales, Christopher Neilson, Sebastián Otero, Gautam Rao
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Scaling up effective policies often requires the attention of frontline bureaucrats with many competing responsibilities. Even when policymakers adopt effective programs, implementation may not follow. In a nationwide experiment in the Dominican Republic, we test interventions to increase school principals' implementation of an educational program proven effective in a previous RCT. Only 37% of control schools verifiably implemented the intervention when ordered to by the Ministry of Education, compared with 83% in the original trial. Implementation was no higher among schools that previously implemented the program in the RCT, suggesting that fixed costs of adoption do not explain non-adoption. We find precise null effects of sharing research evidence, providing modest financial incentives, or offering implementation assistance to principals. In contrast, additional reminder calls increased implementation by 20 percentage points. A second experiment targeting a different mandated program yields the same pattern: reminders produce large effects, while monitoring messages have smaller effects. Our findings point to limited attention among bureaucrats as an important barrier to scaling policies.
abstract_zh: 扩大有效政策的实施规模，往往需要一线行政人员投入精力，而他们通常身兼多项职责。即使政策制定者采纳了有效的项目，执行也可能无法跟进。在多米尼加共和国的一项全国性实验中，我们测试了旨在提高校长执行一项经先前随机对照试验（RCT）证明有效的教育项目的干预措施。当教育部下令实施时，对照组学校中仅有37%可验证地执行了该干预措施，而原始试验中这一比例为83%。在先前RCT中已执行该项目的学校中，实施率并未更高，这表明采纳的固定成本并不能解释未采纳现象。我们发现，分享研究证据、提供适度经济激励或向校长提供实施支持均产生精确的零效应。相比之下，额外的提醒电话使实施率提高了20个百分点。针对另一项强制性项目的第二项实验得出了相同模式：提醒产生显著效果，而监控信息的效果较小。我们的研究结果表明，行政人员注意力有限是政策规模化推广的重要障碍。

title: Different Paths to College Success: The Impact of Massachusetts’s Charter Schools on College Trajectories
title_zh: 通往大学成功的不同路径：马萨诸塞州特许学校对大学轨迹的影响
authors: Sarah R. Cohodes, Astrid C. Pineda
official: 来源期次 American Economic Review: Insights · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The charter school movement encompasses many school models. In Massachusetts in the 2010s, the site of our study, urban charter schools primarily used “No Excuses” practices, whereas nonurban charters had greater model variety. Using randomized admissions lotteries, we estimate the impact of charter schools by locality on college preparation, enrollment, and graduation. Urban charter schools boost all of these outcomes. Nonurban charter schools raise college enrollment and graduation despite reducing state test scores and AP enrollment. Notably, the nonurban charter college graduation edge is more than twice as large as that from urban charter attendance. (JEL H75, I21, I23, I28)
abstract_zh: 特许学校运动包含多种学校模式。在我们研究的马萨诸塞州，2010年代的城市特许学校主要采用"零容忍"实践，而非城市特许学校的模式则更加多样化。利用随机录取抽签机制，我们估算了不同地区特许学校对大学准备、入学及毕业的影响。城市特许学校提升了所有这些指标。非城市特许学校尽管降低了州统考成绩和AP课程注册率，却提高了大学入学率和毕业率。值得注意的是，非城市特许学校带来的大学毕业生优势是城市特许学校的两倍以上。（JEL H75, I21, I23, I28）
